item.title: WXTJ Writes! By Mary Hall: "Does Gambino's Remastered Album Really Shine Brighter?" - WXTJ 100.1 FM
item.description: While this is considered to be a finalized version of 3.15.20 by Gambino himself, the release of Atavista has resulted in some really mixed emotions for me personally.

item.title: WXTJ Writes! By Isabel Xiao: 5 Palestinian Artists To Support - WXTJ 100.1 FM
item.description: As more people around the world learn about the decades-long struggle of the Palestinian people, it becomes more important to shine a spotlight on the culture and music created from the dreams of Palestinian artists.

item.title: WXTJ Writes! By Scarlet M: Your (Possibly) New Favorite Halloween Songs - WXTJ 100.1 FM
item.description: I don’t expect you to add all or even any of these songs to your playlist, but I do hope this inspires you to look for the perfect Halloween song for you.

item.title: WXTJ Writes! By Ella Powell: Defining the Importance and Impact of a Movement through the DIY Music Scene—Here in Charlottesville and Beyond - WXTJ 100.1 FM
item.description: The DIY music scene offers a creative outlet to all who are passionate about music and supporting a message of inclusivity.

item.title: WXTJ Event Conduct Guidelines - WXTJ 100.1 FM
item.description: We take pride in putting on a range of musical programming on grounds. Read our event guidelines here.

item.title: WXTJ Writes! By CC West: Father John Misty Ponders the Meaning of Identity with Mahashmashana - WXTJ 100.1 FM
item.description: After testing the waters of jazz on his last album, Father John Misty circles back to his orchestral rock roots.

item.title: WXTJ Executive Board Statement on DEI at UVA - WXTJ 100.1 FM
item.description: As a freeform radio station created by and for students, WXTJ has always and will always stand for inclusion.

item.title: DJ Interviews: Reggaeton House Show by Dylan Jiron - WXTJ 100.1 FM
item.description: I interviewed the first three DJs of the night during our soundcheck. Read on to learn more about them and the inspiration behind their sets!

item.title: WXTJ Writes! By Meredith Hunsader: The Beaches' No Hard Feelings: A Review of the Canadian Rockers' Third Album - WXTJ 100.1 FM
item.description: The Beaches are known for their queer anthems and songs about lesbian heartbreak, promoting an atmosphere of acceptance and devastatingly fun energy through their work.

item.title: WXTJ Writes! By Phoenix Banks: When the Music Speaks: Soundtracks as the Soul of Cinema - WXTJ 100.1 FM
item.description: Black cinema relies heavily on soundtracks, the music of its people, to communicate directlywith the audience in ways that other movies can’t.
